experiment: E08a: does the reasoning-effort setting take effect?
question: Does the per-run reasoning-effort setting reach the model?
setup: One planning/refactor prompt, no tools, run twice at each reasoning-effort level (low, medium, high) using a per-run override.
finding: The setting takes effect: output averaged about 474 tokens at low and 930 at high, and mean wall time rose from about 17 s to 19 s. An earlier doubt came from a configuration-file warning; the per-run setting works.
limitations: medium's two runs (286 vs 991 tokens) show large run-to-run variance, so effort level is not a precise dial
notes: Models were called through an OpenAI-compatible router; names and prices are as recorded at run time.
